name: Scheme to Provide Assistance to Sate Market Committees as well as Taluka-District Co-operative Purchase and Sale Union to Construct Large Size Warehouse Godowns
benefit: **Component****Support Standard**Large size warehouse godowns up to 5000 MT in market committeesAll State Market Committees, each without considering the class standards will be paid ₹6,500/- per metric ton up to 50% of the project cost will be available for godowns up to 5000 mt
_eligibility_text:
- All State Market Committees in Gujarat are eligible to apply.
- The godowns must be used exclusively for the storage of farmers' produce.
